contentBlocks.text: How to Change Your SASSA Payment Method
You can change how you receive your SASSA grant at any time. Whether you want to switch from bank transfer to Cash Send, or update your bank account details, the process is simple.
This guide is for SASSA beneficiaries who want to switch between bank transfer, Cash Send retail collection, or the SASSA card payment methods.

steps.title: Log into the SRD portal
steps.description: Go to srd.sassa.gov.za and log in with your ID and phone number.

steps.title: Navigate to Payment Method
steps.description: Find the 'Payment Method' section on your dashboard.

steps.title: Select your new method
steps.description: Choose between Bank Transfer, Cash Send, or SASSA Card.

steps.title: Confirm your selection
steps.description: Review your choice and confirm. You will receive an SMS confirmation.

steps.title: Wait for next payment cycle
steps.description: Changes take effect from the following month's payment.

contentBlocks.title: Important
contentBlocks.text: Changes made after the 20th of the month will apply from the following month. Do not change your payment method while a payment is processing.

faqs.question: How long does it take for a payment method change to take effect?
faqs.answer: Changes made before the 20th of the month usually take effect for the current month's payment. After the 20th, they apply from the next month.

faqs.question: Can I switch from Cash Send to bank transfer mid-month?
faqs.answer: Yes, but the change will apply from the following month. You will receive the current month's payment via Cash Send.
